retrieve_nearest_neighbors: retrieve nearest neighbors of sentences from a text bank using PyTorch embeddings
run_flat_retrieve_cli: run the flat_retrieve CLI to find K nearest neighbor sentences for query embeddings
normalize_embeddings: normalize sentence embeddings using L2 normalization before similarity scoring
score_and_rank_similarities: compute cosine similarity scores between bank and query embeddings and rank top-K results
fetch_retrieved_text: fetch and print retrieved text snippets from a compressed text bank using memory-mapped indexing
